dublin-wicklow-mountains-and-glendalough.title: Dublin · Wicklow Mountains and Glendalough
dublin-wicklow-mountains-and-glendalough.slogan: A 99 km loop out of Sally Gap
dublin-wicklow-mountains-and-glendalough.story: Bog road light, ancient stones and a close-to-city classic. A 99 km loop that starts and ends near Blessington, about 1 h 54 of riding. It goes by way of Glendalough and Laragh. Wicklow Gap is the high point. The passes are the reason to go.
